config.encoder: theta(d) = W @ Chebyshev features T_0..T_K of d, scaled from the training range to [-1, 1]
config.loss: mean energy over the training spacings (no energy labels)
config.uccsd_per_point: best of three starts: HF, warm start sweeping up, warm start sweeping down
config.optimizer: L-BFGS-B, central finite-difference gradient (batched), chain rule for the encoder
